source_of_truth: Read by hand in app/components/forms/AccessibleForm.vue: every control and pattern is correct and each is a known false-positive trap for the a11y rules. The email is labelled by

forbidden.why_not_a_defect: the email input is labelled by <label for="email"> and the select is wrapped in a <label>; both have accessible names
the aria-invalid input links its error via aria-describedby="email-error"
the icon button has aria-label="Open help" and the submit button has visible text
the informative image has a descriptive alt and the decorative image has alt=""
the <dialog> is named by aria-labelledby="dlg-title" pointing at its heading
the outline is sequential: h1 then h2, no level skipped
a pending ref guards re-entrant submits and the submit button is :disabled while pending
